app_tagline: [ગુજરાતી] Speak your problem. We find your scheme.
consent_body: [ગુજરાતી] We collect only minimum details to match you with government schemes. Voice recordings are kept securely for 30 days and then automatically deleted. You can delete your data at any time from Settings.
mode_selection_title: [ગુજરાતી] How would you like to use Umeed?
mode_text_badge: [ગુજરાતી] For those who can read and type
mode_text_subtitle: [ગુજરાતી] Type your details in a familiar form.
mode_audio_prompt: [ગુજરાતી] Press the orange button to speak, or the blue button to type.
q_gender: [ગુજરાતી] Are you a woman, a man, or other?
q_state: [ગુજરાતી] Which state do you live in?
q_area: [ગુજરાતી] Do you live in a village or a city?
q_caste: [ગુજરાતી] Which category do you belong to? (General, OBC, SC, ST). You may skip this.
q_income: [ગુજરાતી] About how much does your family earn in a year?
q_occupation: [ગુજરાતી] What work do you do? (Farmer, student, laborer, homemaker, business, other)
q_disability: [ગુજરાતી] Do you have any disability? You may skip this.
q_family: [ગુજરાતી] How many people live in your family?
q_need: [ગુજરાતી] What kind of help do you need most? (Farming, education, health, housing, money, jobs)
caste_why: [ગુજરાતી] Certain government schemes provide special grants, subsidies, or reservations specifically for SC, ST, or OBC categories.
income_why: [ગુજરાતી] Many schemes are meant for families below specific income limits or BPL thresholds.
disability_why: [ગુજરાતી] Special pensions, assistive devices, and quotas exist for persons with disabilities.
handoff_title: [ગુજરાતી] Your recordings have reached a helper
handoff_desc: [ગુજરાતી] A trained civic helper is reviewing your voice responses to complete your profile.
busy_day_desc: [ગુજરાતી] Our helpers are currently busy. We have scheduled a confirmed callback slot for you tomorrow.
reminder_scheduled: [ગુજરાતી] We will send an SMS and notification 15 minutes before your slot.
profile_ready_notification: [ગુજરાતી] Your profile is ready! Tap to view your ranked schemes.
docs_locked_notice: [ગુજરાતી] Documents unlock after speaking to the Help Desk or choosing to skip.
skip_help_desk: [ગુજરાતી] I already understand, skip to documents
physical_office_address: [ગુજરાતી] Or visit nearby CSC / Gram Panchayat office
no_proxy_notice: [ગુજરાતી] Umeed does not submit applications on your behalf. We guide you to the official window.
delete_data_confirm: [ગુજરાતી] Are you sure? This will erase your profile and cached voice recordings immediately.
disclaimer: [ગુજરાતી] Disclaimer: Umeed is an informational and guidance tool. Final eligibility and approvals are decided solely by the respective government authority.
q_sector_focus: [gu] Which area or sector do you need help in? (Finance, Agriculture, Health, Housing, Education, Jobs, Pension)
choose_gist_language: [gu] In which language would you like your scheme summary and gist?
query_help_desk: [gu] Have a question about this scheme? Ask the Help Desk
type_query_hint: [gu] Type or speak your question for the helper...
